mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio_render (composition_hash, composition_json) VALUES (#{hash}, #{json}) ON CONFLICT (composition_hash) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL, progress = 0 WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE audio_render SET progress = #{progress} WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'DONE', file_key = #{fileKey}, duration = #{duration}, progress = 100 WHERE composition_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE composition_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PENDING', file_key = NULL, duration = NULL, progress = 0 WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DONE')
UPDATE audio_render SET status = 'PENDING' WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE audio_render SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE composition_hash = #{hash} AND (last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audio_render WHERE (status = 'DONE' AND COALESCE(last_used_at, updated_at) < NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days})) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days})) ORDER BY id
SELECT composition_hash FROM audio_render WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at
